visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot focusing on a large, golden-brown fried chicken leg being pulled apart by two hands; visible wisps of steam rise from the tender white meat. A middle-aged man with short black hair and a white button-down shirt is visible in the blurred background, smiling directly at the lens. (2) The scene cuts to the man walking outdoors on a sunny city sidewalk. He is wearing a white short-sleeved shirt over a white T-shirt and black shorts, carrying a black messenger bag. He turns his head to address the camera while walking past a shop with glass doors. (3) The man enters a restaurant with bright indoor lighting and wood-textured walls. He points toward a wall-mounted menu displaying various bento meal photos and price tags such as 120 and 135 NTD. (4) He is seated at a dark wooden table indoors. In front of him is an open rectangular wooden bento box containing white rice topped with green leafy vegetables, a halved braised egg, and thin brown noodles. He uses wooden chopsticks to point at the side dishes. (5) A medium shot shows several other male customers in casual attire standing in a queue near the service counter. The restaurant interior features warm wooden panels and clear signage. (6) Returning to a close-up, the man takes a large, enthusiastic bite of the fried chicken leg, his facial expressions showing intense satisfaction. (7) He continues to eat rice from the box using chopsticks, talking excitedly. Another man wearing glasses and a black shirt is partially visible sitting next to him. The man in white points his finger towards the camera in a concluding gesture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, upbeat electronic pop BGM featuring a steady synthesizer pulse and a clean percussion beat. A high-pitched, sizzling sound effect mimics the sound of escaping steam. A male voice speaks with high arousal and a friendly, energetic tone. (2) As the setting changes to outdoors, the BGM continues while low-frequency urban traffic noise and wind floor become audible. The speaker's delivery is fast and enunciated. (3) Upon entering the restaurant, the outdoor hum is replaced by indoor room resonance and soft, multi-layered background chatter. The male speaker's voice remains dominant and projected. (4) Rhythmic clicking sounds of chopsticks against a container and the rustle of plastic are clearly heard. The speaker's pitch variability is high as he describes various food items. (5) Occasional mid-frequency whoosh sound effects mark visual transitions. The speaker's volume is consistent, maintaining high dominance. (6) Exaggerated cartoonish crunching and wet chewing sound effects are layered over the mix to emphasize eating. The speaker lets out a sharp vocal surge of excitement. (7) The BGM swells slightly for the conclusion. The speaker uses a rising intonation pattern to ask a question to the audience before the audio fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Intro -> Product Detail -> Performance/Review -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a personal food review of a long-standing bento shop. The creator uses a 'nostalgic quality' angle, emphasizing that despite the price doubling over 15 years, the cleanliness of the ingredients and the juiciness of the signature fried chicken leg make it worth the cost. The fast-paced editing and energetic vocal delivery aim to build excitement and trust in the recommendation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator specifically identifies the rice source (Chishang Rice) and showcases the brand logo of the shop while providing a highly positive review based on 15 years of personal consumption.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality social media food vlog characterized by synchronized visual/audio emphasis on textures (steam, crunch).
